reward_effort_source: delivered electrical motor effort; excludes passive leg and wheel friction
evaluation_policy: Read-only diagnostics may report poor height, speed, reward, drift or contact behavior. They never pause, stop, restart, restore or shorten the learner budget.
interpretation: User 2026-11-03 explicitly removes all intermediate behavior continuation gates and automatic save/exit reviews. Train through the original fixed budget; manual trainctl controls remain authoritative.

Restore original Wheelbipe saved-checkpoint velocity and height reward weights and error scales. The v202 projection cost remains explicit, and physical friction is excluded from electrical motor reward payment.
Expose the full requested v202 height range from the first rollout. The initial narrow speed/yaw course and later phase boundaries remain explicit.

Physical gas springs, requested randomization, armature 0.015795 kg*m^2 and 50/200 Hz remain. V4 uses PD80/1.5, virtual paired-target overtravel 0.2 rad per boundary and partial inward-only spring cancellation; solver settings remain explicit CLI choices.
Zero-command drift and policy-observation-boundary closed-chain distance are diagnostics without new stopping thresholds.

Manual release/stop saves complete learning state and exits; manual pause may retain GPU memory. Explicit same-course resume restores the original fixed budget and learning state, with physical episodes/history reset.
Training completion and diagnostic scores do not qualify the permanent 13 capabilities, full self-righting, terrain, perturbations or hardware.
Explicit disjoint quotas retain nonzero standing, forward, reverse, height, turn, dash and spin exposure. Jump and airborne lanes cannot overwrite them.
Command timing uses only elapsed time and external requests. Physical contact/apex/support affect reward and diagnostics only.
User explicitly authorizes a new complete fresh mixed jump policy after fixing reward and command integration; old continuation gate and frozen source remain historical.
Environment count is explicit, budget is 20000 PPO updates, and training must use trainctl resident pause/resume. This profile does not authorize starting a learner.
The jump request, apex and clock retain seven reserved observation slots. The common height slot now exposes the time-only preparation trajectory.
During a missed takeoff, idle standing earns no jump preparation or recovery reward. Landing reward requires measured prior flight and contact.
Half of jump lanes gradually acquire forward/reverse commands after update 6000; ordinary movement quotas remain disjoint.
The unchanged 0.3 s quadratic landing buffer is reward-only and never writes physical state or controller targets.
Retain v7 mechanics, calibrated right-leg friction, arc driving, platform tasks, 35/78/6 observation/action ABI and 50/200 Hz clocks.
Replace finite-velocity tracking during push with bounded monotone COM velocity improvement and a once-only measured release-energy bonus. No extra payment for motor torque or force alone.
Impact penalties measure only contacts following confirmed flight; high takeoff support is not landing impact.
Require bilateral tuck hold, pre-contact re-extension and post-contact compression for active-jump sequence success; 40 mm minimum tuck retained.
Separate whole-body COM, actual wheel clearance, electrical work and vertical impulse from root-frame and mixed-population diagnostics.
Physical capability targets are uncalibrated until the offline high-output sweep is measured. Normalization scales are reward units, not declared hardware limits.

jump.landing_horizontal_criterion: body-frame XY velocity error relative to the current command below 0.15 m/s; stationary requests retain the original stop criterion
jump.tuck_geometry_source: body-relative wheel-to-chassis length proxy; identical to jump_air_placement geometry

sequence_objective.energy_source: mass-weighted body COM at first two-wheel air sample, confirmed after minimum_air_seconds; reward/diagnostics only
sequence_objective.push_payment: 4 * increase in best (1-exp(-(positive COM vz / 2 m/s)^2)) before first flight during measured supported push; no fixed takeoff-speed maximum
sequence_objective.release_payment: 4 * (1-exp(-positive release COM vz^2/(2*g*0.25 m))) once per confirmed active flight; height scale is a reward normalizer, not a reachability bound
sequence_objective.success: active jump (including platform requests): >=40 mm bilateral retraction held 40 ms before extension, then >=25 mm bilateral extension in air and >=20 mm bilateral compression after contact, >=40 mm COM rise; original apex/top, stable contact and posture gates retained
sequence_objective.limits: unchanged 40..110 deg, leg +/-40 Nm, wheel +/-4.5 Nm; no external force or velocity assistance
sequence_objective.benchmark_status: not_measured; no claim of maximum height or hardware qualification

reward_policy.unchanged: foundation-v2 safety, orientation, XY/yaw, motor effort, action costs and non-jump rewards
reward_policy.added: Measured COM velocity improvement/release energy, actual bilateral wheel clearance, bilateral tuck hold/reextension/compression sequence; impact gated on prior measured flight
reward_policy.landing_buffer: reward-only partial replay of WheelBipe's 0.3 s quadratic landing trajectory: starts after 20 ms of wheel contact while descending above target+margin, uses root height and vertical velocity observations, temporarily replaces the post-contact height reference during the buffer, and applies no external assistance or command-state transition
reward_policy.units: Densities times policy_dt once; physics-integrated improvement and event payments divided by policy_dt before inherited payment; raw legacy shapes remain separate tags
reward_policy.advantage_normalization: original RSL-RL global normalization retained; task-specific reward and sample metrics logged
reward_policy.scale_status: Analytical and native preflight required; learned behavior is evaluated independently
reward_policy.jump_effort_cost: joint_torque retains 0.5 of base during request, with a further 0.1 in the measured supported push (=0.05 base); ordinary tasks unchanged; no reward for saturation

observation_contract.jump_context_source: external request parameters and elapsed time only
observation_contract.physical_event_observer: reward and diagnostics only; cannot advance command clock
observation_contract.jump_height_command: time-only crouch/push/flight reference, using the existing height command slot; no physical contact or event advances this reference

initialization: fresh actor, fresh critic, empty Adam; new reward and success contract, cannot resume v5/v6/v7 as the same experiment

closed_chain_monitoring.user_instruction: 2026-11-06: isolated closure outliers must not block jump integration; inspect prevalence

control.actual_mechanical_protection: unchanged 40..110 degree geometry, actual-angle outward torque guard, +/-40Nm motor cap; sum PD and FF before clipping
control.scope: training-side candidate only; RMCS deployment is unchanged and requires the same control contract before export/use
control.virtual_pair_overtravel_eligibility: External active jump request only, including crouch/push/flight/recovery until outcome deadline. Ordinary tasks, passive drops and pre-request standing retain mechanical target bounds.

course_scaling_policy.scaled: motion phases, special-mode spin thresholds, jump difficulty and moving-jump progression
course_scaling_policy.unchanged: physical episode timing, rewards, task quotas, observation ABI and actuator settings
course_scaling_policy.effective_contract: params/course.json and its canonical SHA-256 participate in the managed source/course identity

arc_commands.lanes: forward, reverse and dash resamples; yaw sign random; |vx*yaw| <= 2.5 m/s^2 stays below wheel slip at ground mu 0.3

platform.geometry: one static box per platform lane under its own env prim (per-env collision group); length x width x lane height, near face at env-local x = near_edge_x_m, robot heading +x
platform.modes: over (raised step-jump up, cross the top, drive off the far edge) with probability over_fraction, else drive-off from the top; lanes whose box exceeds the unlocked height run flat moving jumps 40 m away
platform.request: explicit step-jump request fired when deployable signed wheel odometry since reset reaches the sampled run-up, or at request_deadline_s; aux jump_request=1, requested_apex from step_reference, stair slot=rise (m). Locked lanes use the time-based flat-jump request. Drive-off and the far edge get no request, only the forward command.
platform.terrain_use: box geometry and contact feed only rewards, success/acceptance and diagnostics; never the actor, the command clock or the request trigger
platform.success: step-up: jump-observer success gated on both wheels supported on top (replaces the apex gate; tuck gate stays jump-lane only); drive-off: both wheels on the floor after a drop and calm for landing_hold_seconds

step_reference.basis: CAD chassis hull: front/rear armor 0.27 m wide at x +/-0.25..0.29 m, 0.143 m below the root; belly 0.181 m below at |x|<0.05. At the 0.305 m stance the front armor is 0.162 m above the floor and reaches a 20 cm face 0.29 m before the wheels, so the flat crouch jump only clears both above ~1.1 m/s. The step reference raises the stance until the armor clears the rise (+4.5 cm), crouches no lower than rise+1 cm under the armor, and pushes from near-full extension (release <= 0.42 m, leg range ends at 0.438 m).
step_reference.example_0_20_m: stance 0.388, crouch 0.353, release 0.42, apex 0.47 (release 0.99 m/s, ~0.75 g push), wheels need ~15 cm of tuck to pass with 1 cm margin
step_reference.deployment: RMCS must reproduce this reference for the step-jump request (height slot), with stair slot = rise
